tokens.description: Semantic colors in light and dark themes. The app owns its final palette.
tokens.props: Define all success/warning/critical/info variables for both themes; map them in Tailwind.

form.description: Validation, disabled fields, pending submission and submit failure. Expand the extended field example below.
form.props: Form: form, children. Fields: label, description, required, disabled. SubmitButton reads form state.

data-table.description: Search, sort, pagination and simulated loading/empty/error responses. Previous query results remain visible during page changes.
data-table.props: table, label, isLoading, toolbar, empty, pagination, onRowClick, rowContextMenu.

list-filters.description: Search and severity filters update the list state and reset its page.
list-filters.props: ListSearchInput: list, label. ListFilterSelect: list, field, label, allLabel, options.
list-filters.code:
<ListSearchInput list={list} label="Search" />
<ListFilterSelect list={list} field="severity" label="Severity" options={options} />

row-actions.description: Try menu and header actions. Actions update a local status message only.
row-actions.props: actions, label, inHeader. Actions support href/onSelect, hidden, destructive and separator.
row-actions.code:
<RowActions label="Manage item" actions={[
  { key: 'edit', icon: <IconPencil />, label: 'Edit', onSelect: openEditor },
]} />

confirm-dialog.description: Compare normal, disabled, pending and error states. Confirmation never deletes data here.
confirm-dialog.props: open, title, description, confirmLabel, onConfirm, onClose; pending, disabled, error, destructive.
confirm-dialog.code:
<ConfirmDialog open={open} title="Delete item?" description="Review before continuing."
  confirmLabel="Delete" destructive pending={pending} error={error}
  onConfirm={remove} onClose={close} />

app-dialog.description: Mount to open; close to unmount. No application route or API is called.

page-header.description: Title, subtitle and actions, including a long heading for layout checks.

detail-list.description: Label/value pairs. Long values and missing values are app-owned decisions.
detail-list.props: DetailList: children, className. DetailItem: label, children, className.

side-panel.description: Resize the viewport: the side panel becomes a disclosure on narrow containers.

enum-badge.description: Severity badges using the shared semantic colors.
enum-badge.props: value, label, classNames; standard Badge props.

user-avatar.description: Initial fallback, an empty name, and a failed image URL. Hover for the full name.
user-avatar.props: name, imageUrl; standard Avatar props. Requires TooltipProvider.

permission-grid.description: Read-only grouped permissions. It displays grants; authorization belongs on the server.

feedback.description: Compare loading text, page loading, request errors and form errors.
feedback.props: LoadError: error. ErrorAlert: message (undefined hides it). LoadingText: className.

status-pages.description: Empty, not-found and route error states. The error preview deliberately logs its sample Error.
status-pages.props: StatusPage: title, description, children. ErrorPage: error, retry. NotFoundPage: homeHref.

session-expired-dialog.description: Simulate the core session-expired flag. The sign-in action reloads this demo page to clear the flag; it does not authenticate.
session-expired-dialog.props: loginPath, returnToParam. Mount once under NextIntlClientProvider; browser API 401s mark the store.

logout-form.description: Posts to a playground-only endpoint and returns here. It does not end any real session.
logout-form.props: action, className, children(pending). Real apps provide their own logout POST endpoint.

query-provider.description: The root layout mounts QueryProvider. Retry and invalidation below use that real provider with an in-memory query.
query-provider.props: children. Browser client is shared; server rendering creates a new client.

app-link.description: BasePathProvider prefixes internal links. These examples point to existing demo routes.
app-link.props: AppLink: standard Next Link props. BasePathProvider: basePath, children.

app-shell.description: Full-page shell with sidebar, navigation, breadcrumb and a demo user. Logout uses a playground-only endpoint.
app-shell.props: AppShell (server): sidebar, breadcrumb, actions, children. AppSidebar: logo, homeLabel, user, children, logoutAction.

locale-switcher.description: Changes the actual playground locale cookie. Component UI messages switch between English and Thai; documentation stays English.
locale-switcher.props: LocaleSwitcher: no props. App must supply i18n/config.ts and i18n/actions.ts; mount DocumentLang to sync html lang.
